output.headline: Advent can add the target to its open platform in the sub-sector, with a 15.5x median multiple paid and 83% of deals closed.
output.differentiator: Brings an open platform in the sub-sector for an add-on route, and a 15.5x median paid, above the 15.3x comparable 75th percentile. Peer lines were not available to compare.
output.why_them: Add-on to its open platform; pays above the comparable 75th percentile

acquirer_overview.title: A sponsor with an 18-deal, provider-weighted record since 2016
points: 18 deals from 2016 to 2024; 15 closed (83%) and 17 of 18 were control deals (94%) [T:record, K:closed_share, K:control_share].
Provider record: 1 deal in the target's own sub-sector and 7 in adjacent provider sub-sectors, against 10 outside provider services [T:record].
Flagship fund Advent Global Private Equity X, about $25 billion (2022 vintage); approximately $100 billion AUM as of November 2025 [P:1, P:2].

strategic_fit_thesis.title: An add-on to an open platform, backed by a provider record
points: Deals in this or neighbouring sub-sectors are a modest factor, the strongest in its likelihood, with past deal count a further slight factor [S:sector_rel, S:activity].
The open platform in the sub-sector makes the target an add-on rather than a new bet, and size fits its usual range [A:angles, S:not_smaller].
Margin Improvement drove 7 of 18 deals, a motive that suits a business with a 16.8% margin [M:margin_improvement, X:target].

precedent_activity.title: Closest precedent is the 2024 Crest Care Partners recapitalization
points: Crest Care Partners: $304M Recapitalization in 2024 at 9.3x EV/EBITDA, in the target's own sub-sector [D:MA-2024-0120].
Behavioral health: Crown Addiction Treatment ($123M, 2023, 14.6x) and Principal Counseling ($163M minority, 2021, 13.2x) [D:MA-2023-0108, D:MA-2021-0341].
Summit DSO: $303M Merger of Equals in the Midwest, 2018, at 11.7x; 8 of 18 deals sit in the $100M-$400M band [D:MA-2018-0184, K:size_band].

valuation_context.title: Defend the 75th percentile; the bid needs the platform exit
points: 70 comparable deals span 10.7x to 15.3x EV/EBITDA (median 12.8x). The target's 16.8% margin beats the 12.9% comps median, supporting the 75th percentile [V:comps].
Advent's own median paid is 15.5x, above the comparable 75th percentile of 15.3x [V:comps].
At 5.0x leverage and a $128M equity cheque, IRR at the ask is 18.7% against a 20% target; maximum price is $193M, or $216M on a platform exit [V:lbo].

risk_flags.title: Return at the asking price
risk_flags.concern: IRR at the ask of 18.7% is below the 20% target [V:lbo].
risk_flags.mitigant: A platform exit at 15.0x lifts the maximum price to $216M [V:lbo].
risk_flags.reality: Same-exit maximum is $193M, so the bid works only if it underwrites the add-on exit [V:lbo].

risk_flags.title: Thin Midwest record
risk_flags.concern: Only 1 deal in the target's region; regional fit is a slight factor against [T:record, S:geo_fit].
risk_flags.mitigant: That deal, Summit DSO, was a $303M Midwest transaction in 2018 [D:MA-2018-0184].
risk_flags.reality: A slight factor; the sector and platform signals outweigh it in the likelihood [S:sector_rel, S:geo_fit].

risk_flags.title: Little own-sub-sector depth
risk_flags.concern: Only 1 of 18 deals is in the target's own sub-sector; 10 are outside provider services [T:record].
risk_flags.mitigant: Adjacent provider deals number 7, and 83% of all deals closed [T:record, K:closed_share].
risk_flags.reality: Experience is adjacent rather than direct; the open platform is the bridge [A:angles].

conviction.rationale: Based on 1 deal in the target's own sub-sector and 7 in adjacent provider sub-sectors, plus an open platform in the sub-sector giving an add-on route [T:record, A:angles].
